App.title: PAIBOT.app
App.description: Explore PAIBOT apps and cloud utilities. We are building tools for operations, organizing information, and automation.

ip.title: IP Address Check
ip.description: Check the IPv4 and IPv6 addresses your browser is currently using.

wc.title: Character Count
wc.description: Count the characters in the text you enter.

arith.title: Arithmetic Practice
arith.description: Practice addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division problems.

age.title: Birth Year Lookup
age.description: Enter your age to find the year you were born, in both the Western and Japanese era calendars.
age.note: In years when the Japanese era changed (1868, 1912, 1926, 1989, 2019), the era name depends on the birth month. Use this table as a guide.

password.title: Password Generator
password.description: Choose your options to instantly create a secure password.
password.emptyWarning: Select at least one character type

base64.title: Base64 Converter
base64.description: Convert text to and from Base64.
base64.inputPlaceholderEncode: Type or paste the text to convert
base64.inputPlaceholderDecode: Type or paste a Base64 string
base64.invalidError: That isn't a valid Base64 string

urlencode.title: URL Encoder
urlencode.description: Convert text to and from URL-encoded strings.
urlencode.inputPlaceholderEncode: Type or paste the text to convert
urlencode.inputPlaceholderDecode: Type or paste a URL-encoded string
urlencode.invalidError: That isn't a valid URL-encoded string

dice.title: Dice Roller
dice.description: Roll dice and see the result. Choose how many dice to roll.

reaction.title: Reaction Test
reaction.description: Click the instant the color changes. Track your best reaction time.
reaction.tooEarly: Too early! Click to try again

timing.title: 5-Second Click
timing.description: Click exactly 5 seconds after starting. Track your best timing accuracy.

math.title: Math Problem Set
math.description: A problem set covering math topics from elementary through university basics, organized by subject, is on the way.
math.comingSoonBody: We're building a problem set covering math topics from elementary through university basics, organized by subject. Check back soon.

about.title: About paibot.app
about.body: paibot.app is the application surface for PAIBOT. Corporate information stays on paibot.co.jp; this domain is reserved for software, hosted tools, and experiments that are meant to be used.
